blocks.text: A street before the house of Mistress Page.
Enter Mistress Page, Mistress Quickly, and William.

lines.text: Is he at Master Ford’s already, think’st thou?

blocks.text: Sure he is by this; or will be presently; but truly he is very courageous mad about his throwing into the water. Mistress Ford desires you to come suddenly.
I’ll be with her by and by; I’ll but bring my young man here to school. Look where his master comes; ’tis a playing day, I see.

lines.text: How now, Sir Hugh, no school today?
No; Master Slender is let the boys leave to play.
Blessing of his heart!

blocks.text: Sir Hugh, my husband says my son profits nothing in the world at his book; I pray you ask him some questions in his accidence.

lines.text: Come hither, William; hold up your head; come.
Come on, sirrah; hold up your head; answer your master; be not afraid.
William, how many numbers is in nouns?
Two
Truly, I thought there had been one number more, because they say “Od’s nouns.”
Peace your tattlings! What is “fair,” William?
Pulcher.
Polecats! There are fairer things than polecats, sure.
You are a very simplicity ’oman; I pray you, peace. What is “lapis,” William?
A stone.
And what is “a stone,” William?
A pebble.
No, it is “lapis”; I pray you remember in your prain.
Lapis.
That is a good William. What is he, William, that does lend articles?

blocks.text: Articles are borrowed of the pronoun, and be thus declined: Singulariter, nominativo; hic, haec, hoc.
Nominativo, hig, hag, hog; pray you, mark: genitivo, hujus. Well, what is your accusative case?

lines.text: Accusativo, hinc.
I pray you, have your remembrance, child. Accusativo, hung, hang, hog.
“Hang-hog” is Latin for bacon, I warrant you.
Leave your prabbles, ’oman. What is the focative case, William?
Scratches his head. O vocativo, O.
Remember, William: focative is caret.
And that’s a good root.
’Oman, forbear.
Peace.
What is your genitive case plural, William?
Genitive case?
Ay.
Genitive: horum, harum, horum.

blocks.text: Vengeance of Jenny’s case; fie on her! Never name her, child, if she be a whore.

lines.text: For shame, ’oman.

blocks.text: You do ill to teach the child such words. He teaches him to hick and to hack, which they’ll do fast enough of themselves; and to call “horum;” fie upon you!
’Oman, art thou lunatics? Hast thou no understandings for thy cases, and the numbers of the genders? Thou art as foolish Christian creatures as I would desires.

lines.text: To Mistress Quickly. Prithee, hold thy peace.
Show me now, William, some declensions of your pronouns.
Forsooth, I have forgot.

blocks.text: It is qui, quae, quod; if you forget your “quis,” your “quaes,” and your “quods,” you must be preeches. Go your ways and play; go.

lines.text: He is a better scholar than I thought he was.
He is a good sprag memory. Farewell, Mistress Page.
Adieu, good Sir Hugh.
Get you home, boy. Come, we stay too long.
